messages:
kevin_sales: Heads-up: HyperEdge POC is flaky. They
re using function-calls + json mode to ingest product metadata. Sometimes the tool call returns fine, other times client JSON parser errors with 'unexpected token' because of stray bytes after the JSON. Also hit a few 429s when they ramped to 80 QPS. They want Dedicated pricing + confirmation about KMS/HSM for the security questionnaire. Can eng & security triage?

nina_eng: can you paste a redacted example of the raw stream? need model name and headers too.

kevin_sales: pasted below (redacted):

```
--STREAM CHUNK--
{"tool":"catalog_extract","result":{"products":[{"sku":"A1","name":"Widget"}]}}
<\x02\x00\x00>\n
parse error at char 310
```

Headers: `x-rw-model: redwood-tool-0.9-q4_0`, `x-client-id: hyperedge-77`

oliver_oncall: 429s likely from client-side parallelism. Did they open 16 workers? Also, which endpoint? streaming or non-streaming?

kevin_sales: they call /v1/stream with 12 parallel workers.

harry_ml: that q4 path is lower precision; we've seen a streaming-flush race that sometimes emits kernel debug footer bytes. Should be fixable in the assembler to drop non-utf8 tails.

nina_eng: plan: 1) add sanitizer to stream assembler to strip non-utf8 trailing bytes and assert final char is } or ] before passing to parser; 2) deliver a fallback wrapper payload like {"_rw_tool_malformed":true, "raw_b64":"..."} so client can recover if we ever strip data.

tia_security: on the SQ: customer asks for HSM-backed keys + audit logs retention 5 years and region eu-central-1. Private deployments can use customer KMS/HSM; Hosted Dedicated supports tenant KMS via our addendum and can be provisioned in eu-central-1. 5-year retention is okay with an export/archival plan. I'll draft response.

linda_sales_ops: preliminary Dedicated ballpark for their expected usage (50k tokens/day, spikes) is ~Yk/mo, reserved minimum is 4 GPUs. I'll pull in finance for exact quote.

ci-bot: [ci 2047.1] sanitizer-stream-fix built. unit tests: \u2705, integration: \u2705, staging deploy queued.

nina_eng: canary target: please add hyperedge-77 to canary routing. oliver, can you open a temporary per-client burst increase so they don't hit 429 during repro?

oliver_oncall: added hyperedge-77 to canary and bumped burst tokens to 180 for 6 hours. Monitoring alert created: https://console.redwood/integrations/hyperedge-77/streams.

kevin_sales: they will run a repro tonight 20:30 UTC. Customer needs stable POC by EOW. If we can show clean JSON + stable throughput, they'll sign.

harry_ml: note: if sanitizer removes data that some tools rely on (e.g., binary blob encoded inline), fallback wrapper will include base64 so no data loss. I'll add config flag `tool_stream_fallback=base64` behind a route feature flag.

nina_eng: good. we'll push canary and validate logs. if green, prepare a one-pager for the customer with config suggestions: reduce parallel workers to 4, client backoff jitter, set allow_malformed_tool_fallback route flag. Also include Dedicated pricing note and the SQ answers.

linda_sales_ops: prepping quote and SLA note now. looping legal for contract language re: KMS and residency.

tia_security: SQ draft posted to the workspace drive. I'll attach to the thread after edits.

kevin_sales: thanks all. will update customer after the 20:30 run. please keep this thread updated with canary results. :pray:
